scope: Independent raw reduction of Three-measured-batch requested matrix; not statistical confidence or full CONTRIBUTING qualification
metric_scope: Server prefill elapsed excludes initial queue but includes scheduler elapsed time, not pureGPUcompute. Client TTFT is first nonempty text arrival; delivery TPOT and server mean decode interval are averages, not per-token ITL distributions. Chunk gaps are transport chunk gaps. Rate and latency change percentages retain their own denominators; no acceptance threshold.
